duties.title: Technical glitch framework: yearly capacity plan of the trading systems
duties.due_text: Every year (every half year for a specified stockbroker): plan the capacity of servers, network, bandwidth and application serving from two years' growth carried three years forward; monitor the peak load; keep installed capacity well above it. No day is set; Ledgerline dates it 31 March.
duties.evidence: The capacity plan, peak-load figures and the review minutes

refs.title: Review of technical glitches framework for stock brokers
refs.says: Capacity planning and peak load monitoring. Gap report rows: CYBER-0293, SEBI-NEW-0023, SEBI-SB2-0147.

refs.title: Annexure-1: joint exchange guidelines on technical glitches
refs.says: Capacity planning from 2-year growth extrapolated 3 years. Gap report rows: MCX-0121.

api.detail: Kept by the firm; produced at inspection or audit.

ledgerline.what: Ledgerline's own load and data figures for the plan

duties.title: Technical glitch framework: yearly review of testing, traceability and change management
duties.due_text: Every year: test environments; unit, functional, regression, security and performance tests; a traceability matrix of functions to test cases for critical systems; a documented change process approved by the Governing Board; the exchanges' mock sessions before each live change. No day is set; Ledgerline dates it 31 March.
duties.evidence: Test records, the traceability matrix, change approvals and mock participation

refs.title: Review of technical glitches framework for stock brokers
refs.says: Rigorous testing before production. Gap report rows: CYBER-0294.

refs.title: Annexure-1: joint exchange guidelines on technical glitches
refs.says: Test environments, traceability, change management, mock testing. Gap report rows: MCX-0123, MCX-0124, MCX-0125.

api.detail: Kept by the firm; produced at inspection or audit.

ledgerline.what: Ledgerline's release test evidence for its own part

duties.title: Technical glitch framework: LAMA monitoring and BCP-DR as the exchanges size them
duties.due_text: Every year: the exchanges' API-based logging and monitoring (LAMA) with logs kept, and BCP-DR (DR in a different seismic zone, drills, RTO and RPO) as the exchanges' size-based guidelines require; small brokers are exempt from BCP-DR. No day is set; Ledgerline dates it 31 March.
duties.filed_with: Kept by the firm; the exchanges' LAMA
duties.evidence: LAMA connectivity, DR drill reports with RTO/RPO

refs.title: Review of technical glitches framework for stock brokers
refs.says: LAMA and BCP-DR per exchange guidelines. Gap report rows: CYBER-0295, SEBI-NEW-0024, SEBI-SB2-0148.

api.detail: Kept by the firm; produced at inspection or audit.

duties.title: Named a specified stockbroker: meet the enhanced technical glitch obligations within two months
duties.due_text: Within two months of NSE naming the firm among the top 20 by IBT/STWT clients (over 10,000 registered clients as of 31 March).
duties.filed_with: Kept by the firm; NSE on request
duties.evidence: The steps taken for each enhanced obligation

refs.title: Circular 51/2026: specified stockbrokers
refs.says: Para 1-3 and Annexure A. Gap report rows: CYBER-0298, NSE-0206.

api.detail: Kept by the firm; produced at inspection or audit.

ledgerline.what: Ledgerline's glitch register runs this clock and drafts the report

duties.title: Specified stockbroker: half-yearly capacity planning of the trading systems
duties.due_text: Every half year: the capacity plan of the trading systems (MCX-0121: half-yearly for a specified broker). No day is set; Ledgerline dates it 30 September and 31 March.

refs.title: Annexure-1: joint exchange guidelines on technical glitches
refs.says: Capacity planning half-yearly for specified brokers. Gap report rows: MCX-0121.

api.detail: Kept by the firm; produced at inspection or audit.

duties.title: Qualified Stock Broker: VAPT every half year
duties.due_text: A Qualified Stock Broker has its VAPT done by a CERT-In empanelled auditor every half year, whatever its CSCRF category. The dates follow the half-yearly cyber audit (31 December and 30 June); confirm with the exchange.
duties.evidence: The auditor's VAPT report and revalidation

refs.no: SEBI FAQs on CSCRF and Cloud Framework
refs.says: FAQ 14: QSBs do VAPT and cyber audit half-yearly regardless of category. Gap report rows: CYBER-0175, NSE-0188.

api.detail: Kept by the firm; produced at inspection or audit.

duties.title: Qualified Stock Broker: cyber audit every half year (where the category alone makes it yearly)
duties.due_text: A Qualified Stock Broker files the cyber audit every half year even when its CSCRF category alone would make it yearly or none: preliminary report by 31 December (April-September) and 30 June (October-March), ATR by 31 March and 30 September.

refs.no: SEBI FAQs on CSCRF and Cloud Framework

api.detail: Kept by the firm; produced at inspection or audit.

duties.changed: Firms already half-yearly under CC-T-CYBER-AUDIT-HALF (qualified, or with IBT or algo) are left out here so the duty is not doubled.

duties.title: Qualified Stock Broker DP: half-yearly VAPT to CDSL
duties.due_text: Half-yearly VAPT by a CERT-In empanelled auditor: April-September report to CDSL by e-mail by 31 December, ATR by 31 March (and the October-March half likewise six months on).
duties.evidence: The VAPT report and ATR sent to CDSL

refs.says: Half-yearly VAPT (Apr-Sep 2025) by a CERT-In auditor; report by 31 Dec 2025, ATR by 31 Mar 2026. Gap report rows: CYBER-0322.
